W02 (3 of 3) and S4: given skills/admin/data-skew-and-sharing-performance SKILL.md:88 defines ownership data skew as a single user or queue owning more than 10,000 records of one object, and this build routes roughly 480 cases a day to Tier_1_General as the catch-all, when queue-retirement-runbook.md is read, then it records that 10,000-record threshold, names who monitors the open-case count owned by each queue, and states the split-into-buckets remedy that skill documents.
